name: ai-tool-call
title: AI Tool Call
description: One agent tool call as a single line with a status ring that turns from queued to running to done or failed. Opens to show arguments and result.

props.name: status
props.description: Where the call is in its life.

props.name: args
props.description: What the tool was called with. Shown when the row is open.

props.name: result
props.description: What the tool returned. Shown when the row is open.

props.name: summary
props.description: Short note on the right, such as "3 files" or "1.2s".

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.
